title: Unitree Robotics unveils a bodyguard robot capable of lifting the front of a car
text:
Unitree Robotics unveils a bodyguard robot capable of lifting the front of a car | South China Morning Post Video - Video Unitree Robotics unveils ‘kung fu’ robot bodyguard Advertisement 00:48 Unitree Robotics Video China Unitree Robotics unveils a bodyguard robot capable of lifting the front of a car 
 Footage showed the H2-X model performing a variety of stunts, but Unitree did not confirm whether the robot performed autonomously.
 Brian Mikael Cheng Published: 9:39pm, 21 Oct 2026 Read more: https://sc.mp/dea3f0 Unitree Robotics released a video showcasing a new humanoid robot model, H2-X. Dubbed the ‘Kung Fu Legend: Guardian’, the robot can be seen performing various action stunts and acting as a bodyguard. Unitree did not confirm whether the actions in the video were performed autonomously, remote-controlled or choreographed. The footage also does not establish whether the H2-X can identify a threat and respond safely in an unplanned situation.
